items.en: Су-24, два катери, 40 пунктів управління та десятки засобів ППО, РЛС і РЕБ — результати middle strike за вересень (ArmyInform: Su-24, two boats, 40 command posts and dozens of air-defence, radar and EW assets: results of middle strike for September)
items.nl: Su-24, twee boten, 40 commandoposten en tientallen luchtverdedigings-, radar- en EW-middelen: resultaten van 'middle strike' in september (ArmyInform)
items.sEn: Ukraine's Ministry of Defence has published a September tally of its 'middle strike' campaign. According to the ministry, Ukraine's Defence Forces hit more than 30 Russian air-defence, radar and electronic-warfare assets, 40 command posts and more than 50 logistics targets during the month. items.en: Ukraine strikes Novorossiysk naval base; Navy claims Neptune hit on Kalibr frigate Admiral Essen
items.nl: Oekraïne treft marinebasis Novorossiejsk; marine claimt Neptune-treffer op Kalibr-fregat Admiral Essen
items.sEn: On the night of 8–9 September 2026, Ukraine carried out a large combined deep-strike against Russia's naval base and commercial port at Novorossiysk (Krasnodar Krai) and against targets near Anapa and Gelendzhik.
